integrity: Exact formulas and global proof given in RESULT.md; standalone check.py reproduces finite symbolic and physical-matrix tests, which do not replace the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Pure fixed qubit chargers and pure conditional battery states; ideal rank-one charger measurement and outcome-conditioned energy-axis rotations; fixed exchange collisions with 0<eta<1. Zero trajectory dispersion refers to conditional mean energy, not projective energy-readout variance. Feedback/control energy costs excluded. Publication priority qualified.
title: A sharp half-excitation finite-step boundary for phase-corrected collisional quantum charging
